_comment: Difference axes for corpus expansion. The prompt locks the recipe (reading level, sentence length, single turn, structure) and varies only these four. Free-hand generation repeats itself within a hundred documents; forcing the axes apart is what stopped the collapse between batch 1 and batch 2. Batch 1 was almost entirely 'small animal, forest, danger, warm ending' - the axes below exist so that combination cannot dominate. Combinations are assigned deterministically by index rather than sampled, so every value on every axis gets covered evenly instead of by luck.
turns: 开始等一件不会来的事
endings: 慢了半拍才反应过来的

_few_shot._comment: Seeds for the style anchor, copied verbatim from corpus.txt. Aiming a model at a description of the register produces a nearby register; aiming it at actual documents produces that register. Rotating which two appear per request stops the model from learning a fixed template of two.
